label: Early copy phase of long sequences (recalling tokens 2-4, L>=8)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires during original input or on the <DEL> step. Activity is concentrated in long sequences: L=9 holds 65% of the mass, L=8 27%, and L<=5 essentially none. Within the copy phase it peaks while recalling original positions 2-4 (absolute t 11-13). It almost never fires at recall_idx 0-1, and there is a small secondary bump at the final recall step of L=9 sequences. Magnitude also depends on the input token: p, 3, j, u and k give 3-3.4x lift. Adding a token set raises precision to about 0.73 but halves recall. The position/length predicate captures about 80% of the mass, but precision is only about 0.45 because many steps in that window stay inactive for reasons not tied to any single variable.
